entries.title: Psalms 125:1
segments:
PSALM CXXV. 
 
  The safety of them that trust in God, and the fate of the wicked,   ver. 1-5.   A song of degrees.

entries.title: Psalms 125:3
segments: V. 3. The rod-Their power and authority.  Not rest-Not continue long.  The lot-Upon the habitations and persons of good men. Lest-Lest they should be driven to indirect courses to relieve themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 125:5
segments: V. 5. Lead them-Unto sinful courses. Israel-Upon the true Israel of God.
